description: This file defines configuration options and installation function for Abseil's failure signal handler, which captures debugging info like stack traces upon program failure. It includes a struct for options, a function to install the handler, and internal utilities.

classes.name: FailureSignalHandlerOptions
classes.description: Struct holding configuration options for the failure signal handler, including symbolization, alternate stack usage, alarm timeout, signal chaining, and a custom writer function.

methods.name: InstallFailureSignalHandler
methods.description: Function to install the failure signal handler with specified options, enabling debugging info capture on fatal signals.
